title: Evaluation of the activity of cardiac glycosides on RORgamma and RORgammaT nuclear receptors.
authors: Karwaciak, Iwona; Pastwinska, Joanna; Salkowska, Anna; Bachorz, Rafal A; Ratajewski, Marcin
one_liner_zh: 该文评估强心苷对RORgamma/RORgammaT核受体的激动作用，虽含分子对接但对象为核受体-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Cardiac glycosides, derived from plants and animals, have been recognized since ancient times. These substances hinder the function of the sodium-potassium pump within eukaryotic cells. Many reports have shown that these compounds influence the activity of nuclear receptors. Thus, we assessed the effects of various cardiac glycosides at nontoxic concentrations on RORgamma and RORgammaT. RORgammaT is a crucial protein involved in the differentiation of Th17 lymphocytes. Sixteen analyzed cardiac glycosides exhibited varying toxicities in HepG2 cells, all of which demonstrated agonistic effects on RORgamma, as confirmed in the RORgamma-HepG2 reporter cell line. The overexpression of both the RORgamma and RORgammaT isoforms intensified the effects of these compounds. Additionally, these glycosides induced the expression of G6PC, a gene regulated by RORgamma, in HepG2 cells. Subsequently, the effects of two endogenous cardiac glycosides (marinobufagenin and ouabain) and the three most potent glycosides (bufalin, oleandrin, and telecinobufagenin) were evaluated in Th17 primary lymphocytes. All of these compounds increased the expression of the IL17A, IL17F, IFNG, and CXCL10 genes, but they exhibited varying effects on GZMB and CCL20 expression. Molecular docking analysis revealed the robust binding affinity of cardiac glycosides for the ligand binding domain of the RORgamma/RORgammaT receptors. Thus, we demonstrated that at nontoxic concentrations, cardiac glycosides have agonistic effects on RORgamma/RORgammaT nuclear receptors, augmenting their activity. This potential can be harnessed to modulate the phenotype of IL17-expressing cells (e.g., Th17 or Tc17 lymphocytes) in adoptive therapy for combating various types of cancer.
abstract_zh: 强心苷类化合物源自植物和动物，自古以来就已被认识。这些物质阻碍真核细胞内钠钾泵的功能。许多报道表明，这些化合物影响核受体的活性。因此，我们评估了多种强心苷在无毒浓度下对RORgamma和RORgammaT的影响。RORgammaT是参与Th17淋巴细胞分化的关键蛋白。十六种分析过的强心苷在HepG2细胞中表现出不同的毒性，所有化合物均显示出对RORgamma的激动作用，这一点在RORgamma-HepG2报告细胞系中得到证实。RORgamma和RORgammaT两种亚型的过表达增强了这些化合物的效应。此外，这些强心苷在HepG2细胞中诱导了由RORgamma调控的基因G6PC的表达。随后，评估了两种内源性强心苷（marinobufagenin和ouabain）以及三种最有效的强心苷（bufalin、oleandrin和telecinobufagenin）在Th17原代淋巴细胞中的效应。所有这些化合物均增加了IL17A、IL17F、IFNG和CXCL10基因的表达，但对GZMB和CCL20的表达表现出不同的影响。分子对接分析揭示了强心苷与RORgamma/RORgammaT受体配体结合域的强结合亲和力。因此，我们证明了在无毒浓度下，强心苷对RORgamma/RORgammaT核受体具有激动作用，增强其活性。这一潜力可用于过继疗法中调节表达IL17的细胞（如Th17或Tc17淋巴细胞）的表型，以对抗多种类型的癌症。
